messages:
evan: Heads-up: Acme Corp requested a scoped private pilot next quarter. Need cross-team alignment on perf, infra, and security.

sophia: Can product define minimal acceptance? Without clear gates we waste time.

evan: Minimal acceptance: stable perf within expected cost envelope, security light-review passed, infra staging available for 1 week of soak.

raj: Runtime: quant + KV-cache validation for 4B model. I can do a fast baseline in ~6 business days if infra provides sample traces.

mike: Infra: we can carve a 2-node A10 staging cluster. Need budget ticket; provisioning ~3 business days after approval.

security-bot: Note: customer-managed keys requested. HSM path adds ~10bd. Recommend managed KMS for pilot.

sophia: Agreed on managed KMS for pilot. We'll document HSM as phase 2.

ev an: (typo) evan: Thanks. Action items: raj -> baseline + perf numbers by 2026-04-12; mike -> infra ticket and ETA by 2026-04-09; security -> checklist decision by 2026-04-08.

raj: I'll post RFC with numbers and link to RUN-3001 when ready.

mike: INFRA-9022 created with cost estimate. I linked it.

sophia: I'll own the acceptance checklist and add rollback gates. Invite for 20m sync Friday at 10:15 sent.

ev an: Thanks team. Please ack any blockers here.
